title: Human
description: Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common races, gaining +1 to all six ability scores.

title: Elf
description: Elves possess otherworldly grace and sharp intellect (+2 DEX, +1 INT), naturally attuned to magic and archery.

title: Dwarf
description: Dwarves are stout and stalwart defenders (+2 CON, +1 STR) with legendary fortitude, poison resistance, and bonus HP.

title: Halfling
description: Halflings are nimble and cheerful folk (+2 DEX, +1 CHA) gifted with uncanny luck and agility (+1 AC bonus).

title: Dragonborn
description: Dragonborn look very much like dragons standing erect in humanoid form (+2 STR, +1 CHA), bearing elemental breath weapons.

title: Gnome
description: Gnomes take delight in life and invention (+2 INT, +1 CON), possessing keen intellect and resistance to magical effects.

title: Half-Elf
description: Walking in two worlds, half-elves combine human ambition with elven grace (+2 CHA, +1 DEX, +1 CON).

title: Half-Orc
description: Half-orcs exhibit savage strength and relentless endurance (+2 STR, +1 CON), defying death when others would collapse.

title: Tiefling
description: Tieflings carry the infernal heritage of the Lower Planes (+2 CHA, +1 INT), wielding darkvision and fire resistance.
